notes.title: August 2021 Update
notes.content:
Added percentages to each of the starting setup sliders - thanks to Malik Martin
Added a simple background to pretty it up a bit

notes.title: July 2021 Update
notes.content:
Lap logger popup frequency reduced
Fixed inability to select some tire temperature cells - thanks to Robert Nester

notes.title: Dutch translation added
notes.content:
Besides the English, Portuguese, Italian, and Turkish translations, the release of SDT21 will also include a Dutch language translation.
